legacy_inventory.local_acceptance_note: The existing local conversions remain unaccepted. The 2026-10-24 Source Monitor sync retrieved 83 of 84 targets and generated 72 Markdown candidates. All 71 registered document candidates matched their existing document text after normalizing only the converter-version line (0.2.1); no substantive text difference was found. The additional Portal Legislativ candidate OUG nr. 32/2026 (record 309832) has no document path in the manifest and remains archived for scope review; it has not been promoted or accepted. The one failed target was an unlisted FreeWebService WSDL URL: it returned an HTML-formatted service description with a text/xml content type, so the sync’s HTML content-type check rejected it. The sync report, the inspected FreeWebService response, and the two reviewed candidates are archived in the Monitor local research archive under romania-monitor-sync-2026-10-24. This check does not establish later legal currentness or topic coverage. No local file is newly accepted.

policy: A human-reviewed official link is usable for ordinary research within the identified publisher, instrument, language, displayed date or cutoff, reviewed content, and limitations. A government-published consolidated text is preferred when available. No Gazette-fragment reconstruction, local capture, hash, replay, conversion, API access, or copying permission is required for link use. Check a specific later amendment only when it may materially affect the issue. Link acceptance is separate from local-copy acceptance, topic coverage, and country completion.

ro-portal-798-2021-adoption-annex.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-798-2021-adoption-annex.version_or_cutoff: Government Decision nr. 798/2021, published in Monitorul Oficial nr. 761 on 5 August 2021; its Article 1 replaces the annex to HG nr. 579/2016 with the annex reproduced on this official page.
ro-portal-798-2021-adoption-annex.scope: Official text of the replacement methodological rules annex applying Law nr. 273/2004 on adoption procedure, including adoption assessment and procedure provisions.
ro-portal-798-2021-adoption-annex.reviewed_content: The official text identifies the Government as issuer, the instrument and publication data, expressly states that the HG nr. 579/2016 annex is replaced, and provides the full replacement annex. The annex definitions identify central and foreign competent authorities and the Hague Adoption Convention context.
limitations: This remains the official 2021 replacement-annex instrument, not a consolidated current text of every provision of HG nr. 579/2016 or its amendments. A separate official consolidated methodological-rules page, ro-portal-288410-adoption-rules, is now accepted through its displayed 19 September 2024 cutoff; this historical instrument remains useful for the replacement act itself, while post-cutoff currentness stays open.

Article 83(1) of the replacement annex was finally annulled; the official ÎCCJ Decision nr. 326/2025 states that the annulment took effect after publication of the final judgment on 19 September 2024. See https://legislatie.just.ro/Public/DetaliiDocument/303954. Do not rely on Article 83(1) as a ground to refuse the support allowance in the described pre-26 March 2021 adoption situation.
This link decision does not accept a local conversion, establish topic completeness, or close the currentness review offered for human follow-up.

ro-portal-303954-adoption-rule-status.scope: Official judicial confirmation of the final annulment and publication status of Article 83(1) of the methodological rules annex to HG nr. 579/2016, as replaced by HG nr. 798/2021.
ro-portal-303954-adoption-rule-status.reviewed_content: The official decision identifies HG nr. 798/2021 as replacing the HG nr. 579/2016 annex and states that Article 83(1) was finally annulled on 24 April 2024, with the final judgment published in Monitorul Oficial nr. 942 on 19 September 2024. It also states the limited effect of that annulment for the adoption-support allowance scenario described in the decision.
limitations: This is the official 2025 decision's confirmation of the earlier annulment, not the full text of the underlying Court of Appeal judgment or Decision nr. 2.431/2024.
The status point concerns Article 83(1) and the adoption-support allowance context; it is not a general interpretation of the adoption procedure rules.
The link does not accept the existing local decision or rule conversions.

No local copy or attachment is accepted.

human_review_site_offers.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
human_review_site_offers.reason: The official Law nr. 273/2004 record displays a consolidation only through 19 April 2024; its newer direct amendments were not established by a bounded official-domain search on 23 October 2026 (12 queries, 41 result cards, duplicate and irrelevant hits screened). The consolidated HG nr. 579/2016 rules page is available through 19 September 2024 and includes the Article 83(1) annulment note. The official HG nr. 1.441/2004 page states a cutoff of 12 August 2016, but its full text could not be opened in the research viewer and later currentness was not established.
human_review_site_offers.review_question: Can a human reviewer confirm later amendments or consolidated texts for Law nr. 273/2004 after 19 April 2024, the HG nr. 579/2016 rules after 19 September 2024, and HG nr. 1.441/2004 after 12 August 2016; verify the current foreign-organization authorization procedure and list; and preserve the Article 83(1) annulment status?
human_review_site_offers.effect: The accepted Law nr. 273/2004, methodological-rules, HG nr. 1.441/2004 dated reference, HG nr. 798/2021 historical replacement-annex, and ÎCCJ Decision nr. 326/2025 links remain usable only within their stated dates and scopes. This narrowed offer does not block other source or topic research, add monitored targets, or accept local copies.
